description:
Allow raw batched carry-less multiplication to use the target host's YMM VPCLMULQDQ support without requiring AVX512VL.

## Background

The raw clmul_batch dispatcher in crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/clmul.rs requires AVX512VL, excluding the Ryzen 9 5900X despite its VPCLMULQDQ support. FieldVec::simd_dot_product consumes this path. Other $\mathrm{GF}(2^m)$ kernels already use AVX2 plus VPCLMULQDQ at Rust 1.95, providing an established feature-contract pattern.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-07: Establish failing evidence that an AVX2+VPCLMULQDQ host without AVX512VL selects the available YMM raw-batch path, then correct both dispatch and target-feature safety contracts. Detect every actually required feature and retain sequential PCLMULQDQ and portable scalar fallbacks.

- [hard] REQ-08: Match complete 128-bit carry-less products for random and adversarial operands, including zero, high bits, odd batch lengths, empty inputs and non-vector tails; cover the production FieldVec dot-product consumer.

- [hard] REQ-09: Publish a bounded current-code before/after release receipt for a predeclared representative set of small, odd/tail and L1-resident raw batches plus the FieldVec dot-product consumer. Include dispatch and packing costs and the frozen non-regression rule before production adoption. Do not wait for an exhaustive size grid or gf2x build; raw independent products have no assumed equivalent external arm, and any unavailable comparison is explicit.

- [hard] REQ-10: Commit Rust 1.95 assembly showing YMM VPCLMULQDQ on the supported path and verify the exact target-feature safety contract and emitted fallback paths. Limit this change to the measured predicate/safety repair; do not bundle unrolling, fusion or long-polynomial optimization.
title: Repair YMM carry-less multiplication dispatch with measured evidence
